Method of Attack: Overlay fake login pages on legitimate banking apps
Lock user's device via ransomware-like behavior
Intercept SMS messages to bypass two-step verification
Show unsolicited notifications to lure users into fake login screens

Attack Vector: Malicious repackaged Android apps distributed via third-party app stores
Malicious apps uploaded and distributed via Google Play Store
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious apps named 'Good Weather' and 'Weather' on Google Play Store
C&C server control panel source code leaked
Fake login pages targeting banking apps
